sections.text_helper: Section 78.6 "Security" in chapter 78 (Debug support (DBG)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 4378.
sections.section_content:
The trace and debug components allow a high degree of access to the processor, and
system during product development. To protect user code, and to ensure that debug
features cannot be used to alter or compromise the normal operation of the finished product,
these features can be disabled, or limited in scope. For example, a secure software debug
and trace can be disabled without preventing the debug of non-secure code.
